newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg and Danisco rally, boosting Danish index.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg and Danisco rally, boosting Danish index.

text.p: Danish top 20 shares were evenly split between rising and falling stocks on Monday but rallies by two of last week's fallers lifted the index.
At 0900 GMT the KFX top-20 index was up 0.43 point, or 0.25 percent, to 171.25.
Driving the rise was a 12 crown rise by Carlsberg to 368.00 crowns and a five crown gain in Danisco, to 407.00.
Carlsberg plummeted on Friday after the British government blocked the planned sale of its half of joint venture Carlsberg-Tetley to partner Bass.

Danisco took a tumble earlier in the week when it announced a 14 percent rise in 1996/97 profits but said the rate of growth would be less in 1997/98. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
